<USER_REQUEST>
You are implementing the AI controller (C-08) for P3 of Dungeon Haul.

START BY READING:
1. /Users/atarzwell/src/dhaul4/docs/components/ai-controller/DESIGN.md (full document — behavior stack, flocking, greed, switches)
2. /Users/atarzwell/src/dhaul4/docs/components/ai-controller/TASKS.md (C08-T04 through C08-T09, C08-T13)
3. /Users/atarzwell/src/dhaul4/docs/interfaces/input-commands.md
4. /Users/atarzwell/src/dhaul4/packages/protocol/src/input.ts — InputCommand type
5. /Users/atarzwell/src/dhaul4/packages/protocol/src/core.ts — types
6. /Users/atarzwell/src/dhaul4/server/src/sim/simulation.ts — to understand the neutral AI stub

CREATE: `/Users/atarzwell/src/dhaul4/server/src/ai/` directory with:

### 1. `types.ts` — AiWorldView interface
Define the read-only view the sim exposes to AI (DESIGN §4):
```
AiWorldView {
  tick, phase, levelId, biome,
  haulers[4]: { seatId, control, x, y, vx, vy, facing, grounded, stunned, carryCount, carry[], weight },
  freeTreasures[]: { instanceId, defId, x, y, valueGp, rarity },
  switches[]: { switchId, x, y, kind, pressed, requiredMass },
  exitZone?: { x, y, width, height }
}
```

### 2. `helpers.ts` — Pure decision helpers (DESIGN §9)
All must be pure functions, unit-testable, no I/O:
- `averageHumanPosition(haulers)` → Vec2 | null
- `toleranceBand(humans)` → number (25% of furthest pair span)
- `maxHumanLoad(haulers)` → number
- `selectTreasureTarget(self, freeTreasures, cap)` → best treasure or null
- `selectSwitchTarget(self, switches)` → nearest actionable switch or null  
- `axesToward(selfX, targetX, tolerance)` → -1|0|1
- `shouldUpgrade(self, freeTreasures)` → { drop: true, targetTreasure } or null

### 3. `controller.ts` — AiController class
The main `decide(seatId, view, rng)` method implementing the priority cascade (DESIGN §7):
1. Stunned → neutral
2. Switch duty → move to nearest unpressed switch
3. Treasure upgrade → drop lesser if better nearby
4. Treasure pickup → if under load cap and in range
5. Position flock → move toward average human position  
6. Exit bias → if all humans past midpoint
7. Idle → neutral

Config via `AiConfig` (DESIGN §10): pickupRadius=1.5 blocks, switchSeekRadius=10 blocks, toleranceFraction=0.25, etc.

### 4. `config.ts` — AiConfig defaults
Tunable parameters from DESIGN §10.

### 5. Unit tests in `/Users/atarzwell/src/dhaul4/server/test/ai/`
Test cases from DESIGN §11 and TASKS C08-T13:
- Average of 1/2/4 humans; empty humans; tolerance dead-zone no thrash
- Load cap equals max human count; AI refuses 4th when humans hold 3
- Upgrade drops lower value for higher; rarity tie-break
- Switch preference when unpressed nearby
- Stuck recovery fires after stuckTicks

IMPORTANT:
- The AI produces InputCommand just like humans — same shape, same apply path
- AI `seq` is server-side monotonic (not over the wire)
- AI never sends action = true to trip humans (non-goal MVP)
- Fork phase: stable hash path selection + mild argue pulse
- Pickup: set axes.y = +1 (down/duck) when adjacent and canPickup
- Drop chord: action=true, axes.y=+1 for one tick
- Throw: NOT preferred for upgrades (prefer drop)

Run tests: cd /Users/atarzwell/src/dhaul4/server && pnpm test
</USER_REQUEST>
